name: Qingdao Jiaodong International Airport
before:
Qingdao's airport and the largest in Shandong, at Jiaodong in Jiaozhou about 39 km from the city centre. It opened on 12 August 2021, replacing Qingdao Liuting International, so any guidance naming Liuting is out of date.

The metro is the way in. Qingdao Metro Line 8 runs between the airport and Qingdao North railway station, which matters given how far out the airport sits.

It is built for far more than it currently carries. The terminal is rated for 35 million passengers a year and handled 26.9 million in 2025, so it is not congested. Two runways of 3,600 metres are rated class 4F, able to take an A380, with 178 aircraft stands.

The terminal is worth a look: a single 478,000 square metre building laid out in a starfish shape with five airside concourses radiating from the centre, under a stainless steel roof spanning 223,000 square metres.
after:
Qingdao's airport and the largest in Shandong, in Jiaozhou, about 40 km from the city centre. It replaced Qingdao Liuting International, which has closed, so any guidance naming Liuting is out of date.

The metro is the way in. Since 22 September 2026, Line 8 has run from the airport straight into the city centre at May Fourth Square, with no change of train. It also stops at Qingdao North railway station.

The airport handled 26.9 million passengers in 2025. There are two runways, each 3,600 m long.

claims.claim: Line 8 now runs from the airport straight into the city centre at May Fourth Square, no change, since 22 September 2026
claims.inAfter: Since 22 September 2026, Line 8 has run from the airport straight into the city centre at May Fourth Square, with no change of train.
claims.note: Replaces 'Line 8 runs between the airport and Qingdao North railway station', true until the day before this check. Line 8's southern section opened at 05:07 on 22 September 2026 and the 61.4 km line now runs from Jiaozhou North via the airport and Qingdao North to May Fourth Square (五四广场). Qingdao Daily gives about 40 minutes at best, airport to May Fourth Square, and express trains that stop only at May Fourth Square, Xiwujiacun, Qingdao North, the airport and Jiaozhou North; the time has one source and is not in the text.
